units.source_text: 朱雀帝听了遗言，不胜悲痛，再三声言决不违反父命。

en.t: Emperor Suzaku heard the dying words and was overcome with grief, repeatedly declaring that he would never go against his father's command.

units.source_text: 桐壶院看见朱雀帝已长得容姿清整，仪态优越，心甚欣慰。

en.t: When Kiritsubo-in saw that Emperor Suzaku had grown into a man of refined looks and excellent bearing, he was deeply comforted.

units.source_text: 朱雀帝因身份所关，不便久留，只得匆匆还宫，临别不胜依依。

en.t: Because of his position, Emperor Suzaku could not stay long and had to hurry back to the palace, parting with great reluctance.

units.source_text: 皇太子本欲随帝同来，深恐人多嘈杂，故另定日期。

en.t: The Crown Prince had originally wished to come with the Emperor, but fearing the noise and confusion of too many people, they set another date for his visit.

units.source_text: 皇太子虽然年幼，却长得大人模样，而且容姿秀美。

en.t: Although the Crown Prince was still young, he had the appearance of someone older, and his looks were graceful and beautiful.

units.source_text: 他许久不见上皇，时时怀念在心。

en.t: He had not seen the Retired Emperor for a long time and often missed him in his heart.

units.source_text: 现在得见，童心但感喜悦，亲切地仰望慈颜，样子甚是可爱。

en.t: Now that he was able to see him, his child's heart felt only joy, and as he warmly looked up at that kind face, he appeared truly lovable.

units.source_text: 藤壶母后泪痕满面，上皇看了百感交集，无限伤心。

en.t: Empress Mother Fujitsubo's face was covered with tear stains, and when the Retired Emperor saw her, countless feelings welled up in him and he was endlessly saddened.

units.source_text: 他对皇太子嘱咐了许多事情。

en.t: He gave the Crown Prince many instructions.

units.source_text: 只因太子年纪太小，深可担心，不免悲痛。

en.t: Because the prince was still so young, there was much to worry about, and he could not help feeling sorrow.

units.source_text: 他曾反复叮嘱源氏大将，教他勤理朝政，并善视太子。

en.t: He had repeatedly urged General Genji to attend diligently to the affairs of state and to take good care of the Crown Prince.

units.source_text: 太子到了夜深方才告辞，所有殿上人皆陪侍太子同行，其隆重不减于前日朱雀帝之行幸。

en.t: Only late at night did the prince take his leave, and all the courtiers accompanied him in attendance, with a ceremony no less grand than Emperor Suzaku's visit the other day.

units.source_text: 上皇还想留他在侧，时间所限，只得让他回去，临别不胜怅惘。

en.t: The Retired Emperor still wished to keep him at his side, but because time was limited he had no choice but to let him return, and at parting he was filled with wistful sadness.
